verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success, professional skill, or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention securing the future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

operational-specificity-faster-general.title: Providing specific operational or inventory details predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
operational-specificity-faster-general.body: Pitches that include precise details about inventory items or operational data, rather than general categories, fund faster for both men and women.

female-partner-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe the status or occupation of their partner or spouse fund faster.
female-partner-status-faster.body: Pitches from women that include details about the employment or social status of a spouse or partner are associated with increased funding speed.

female-savings-goals-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific future savings goals may fund faster.

female-nwtf-phrasing-faster.body: Female borrowers who use standardized phrasing regarding NWTF loans may fund faster.

female-marital-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly mention that they are married may fund more slowly.

female-hardships-slower.body: Female borrowers who emphasize personal hardships like widowhood or lack of education may fund more slowly.

numerical-divergence-puzzle.body: Numerical quantities may have divergent effects based on whether they describe family size or financial/market specifics.

female-children-ages-slower.body: Female borrowers who specify the exact ages of children or dependents may fund more slowly.

female-virtue-descriptors-faster.body: Female borrowers who use descriptors such as 'hardworking' or 'perseverance' may fund faster.

female-institutional-training-slower.body: Female borrowers who emphasize institutional training or certifications may fund more slowly.

female-institution-name-slower.body: Mentioning the specific name of the lending institution may predict slower funding for women.

female-community-empowerment-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention social or community-focused elements like empowerment or peer education may fund faster.

female-technical-financial-details-slowe.title: Pitches from women that include highly detailed lists of inventory, financial figures, or institutional rules are associated with decreased funding speed.
female-technical-financial-details-slowe.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that exact weights of inventory items can lead to faster funding.

female-family-community-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who include descriptive details about family members or community impact may fund more slowly.
female-family-community-details-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific household details like children or rented housing accelerate funding.

female-operational-details-faster.title: Pitches from women that include precise operational data, such as exact inventory weights or specific working hours, are associated with increased funding speed.
female-operational-details-faster.retrospective: Generalized to gender-neutral claim after similar pattern observed in male pairs.

household-details-faster-general.title: Mentioning specific household details like children or housing status may accelerate funding regardless of gender.
household-details-faster-general.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that explicitly listing the number of children is associated with slower funding.

female-nwtf-mention-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous loans from the NWTF institution are associated with increased funding speed.
female-nwtf-mention-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-children-detail-slower.

female-direct-address-faster.title: Female borrowers who address lenders directly in their pitch may fund faster.
female-direct-address-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that slower pitches used direct address ('Dear lenders').

female-children-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed breakdowns of their children's status fund more slowly.
female-children-detail-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of numerical-quantities-slower-general.

female-gratitude-promises-slower.title: Female borrowers who include explicit gratitude markers or promises to repay may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-promises-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that faster pitches include explicit expressions of gratitude.

numerical-quantities-slower-general.title: Pitches that include precise currency amounts or specific numerical quantities tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.
numerical-quantities-slower-general.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that longevity numbers accelerate funding; retired to maintain claim cap.

business-longevity-faster-general.title: Emphasizing a long duration of business experience or longevity predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-longevity-faster-general.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-partner-status-faster.
